contract: RADAR_FULL_ANALYSIS_GATE_V2: FULL requires certified primary/crosschecked XI, synchronized tactical layer, fresh exact CURRENT BetFlag/AAMS standard prices, explicit market/movement status, and POST-XI delta when required. Single-provider SOURCE_CONFIRMED is PROVIDER_ONLY and cannot be called official. Missing TRUE OPEN never permits a movement claim; CURRENT_ONLY may support PRICE-ONLY value analysis with exact FINAL GATE price. V4: player BET readiness requires explicit fixture-specific BetFlag player_coverage_complete with concrete player rows; Combo BET readiness separately requires combo_coverage_complete with concrete SCORER_COMBO/PLAYER_COMBO rows. Empty player/combo arrays are never COMPLETE. Player readiness additionally requires fresh XI-aligned Player Synergy & Position Context with >=60% baseline coverage.
xi_policy: SOURCE_CONFIRMED from one provider => PROVIDER_ONLY unless explicit official-primary metadata; CROSS_CONFIRMED => CERTIFIED_CROSSCHECK.
movement_policy: Only explicit BetFlag evidence can be TRUE_OPEN/OPEN_RADAR. FIRST_SEEN is diagnostic. CURRENT_ONLY permits no movement claim and cross-book movement never substitutes BetFlag.

betflag_player_combo_coverage_policy.generic_coverage_rule: never use generic coverage_complete as a substitute for player/combo completeness
betflag_player_combo_coverage_policy.not_observed_rule: NOT OBSERVED is pending/recovery, never equivalent to unavailable

synergy_position_policy.small_sample_policy: shrink deltas toward zero; LOW samples cannot create standalone edge
synergy_position_policy.standard_market_gate_effect: none; only player-market BET readiness is blocked
